identity.body: A name and a face. Everything else can come later.
identity.name: Name
identity.nameHint: Shown in chats and on their card

details.title: Who they are
details.body: The definition is what the model reads. Be specific about personality, voice and background.
details.definitionPlaceholder: Personality, speaking style, background, what they know
details.definitionHint: Use {{char}} for the character and {{user}} for your persona.
details.descriptionPlaceholder: A short line for cards and lists
details.descriptionHint: Optional. Not sent to the model.
details.modelMissing: A model that no longer exists
details.memoryBody: Manual notes, or summaries the app keeps
details.promptMissing: A prompt that no longer exists
details.modelHint: Which model answers as this character
details.memoryDynamicBody: Remembers what matters on its own
details.memoryDynamicOff: Turn on dynamic memory in settings to use it

scenes.title: Where it starts
scenes.body: Each scene is a way a chat can begin. The default one is used when you don't pick.
scenes.emptyBody: Add a scene, or skip to details.
scenes.textPlaceholder: *{{char}} looks up from the map.* "You're late."
scenes.directionHint: Optional guidance for how this scene unfolds.
scenes.selectBody: Choose a scene to edit its opening message.
scenes.deleteBody: {{scene}} and its opening message will be deleted.
scenes.emptyWarningBody: Empty scenes will be skipped when you create this character. Add an opening message to keep them.

extras.body: Everything here is optional. Skip it and the character still works.

extras.creator: Creator

extras.lorebooksEmptyBody: Lorebooks you create or import show up here.
